title: Battlefield Hardline console servers shutting down June 2026, removed from storefronts May 22
content: Electronic Arts has announced that Battlefield Hardline, the 2015 police-themed FPS, will shut down on consoles in June 2026. The game will be removed from the PS4 and Xbox One storefronts on May 22, and the multiplayer servers will close on June 22. The single-player campaign will remain playable after the server shutdown for owners.
